title: Stream Input
text: Read formatted ASCII data from communication channel, 4 outputs, {Message termination} sets end of message,; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Block output data types} sets the output type and grouping of data sent to the block, {Format string} sets the format of data items being read, {Show “Data Ready” port} adds port Data Ready that signals 1 when data and {Show “Data Error” port} adds port Data Error that signals 1 if error. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Output Data
ports.summary: Data received from communication channel numeric vector | string

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Block output data types
params.values: Output type and grouping of data sent to the block outputs ’double’ (default) | character vector | cell array of character vector

params.name: Format string
params.values: Format of data items being read from the stream ’%f’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Message termination
params.values: Specify end of message {’\r’, ’\n’} (default) | character vector | cell array of character vector | integer

params.name: Show “Data Ready” port
params.values: Add port Data Ready that signals 1 when data is available ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Show “Data Error” port
params.values: Add port Data Error that signals 1 if error occurs ’off’ (default) | ’on’
